name: Regéc (Hungary)
description: White field with two narrow vertical stripes of blue and yellow at the fly edge, charged at the centre of the white with the municipal arms of Regéc: a crowned blue oval shield with a patriarchal cross and a castle, supported by two yellow lions, above a scroll inscribed REGÉC.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Regéc arms with crown, lion supporters and scroll
